script:
# GS-018: Recover captured carbon from an isolated carbonate solid
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 Ca(OH)2 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
add v1 CO2 0.0005mol
inspect v1
new
filter v1 v2
add v1 water 100mL
seal v1 100mL
add v1 HCl 0.003mol
measure v1 pressure
inspect
